detail: County museum records the historical period as 1877–1898 on the high bluff at the rivers’ junction, and confirms none of the fort buildings survive.
The U.S. National Archives preserves two strikes showing the measured parade ground, buildings, the scale and the orientation.
Federal named historical reservation location in the Hardin quadrangle. The site placement uses this vicinity with the original topography and archival relative plan.
The 1886 War Department documentation uses the Fort Custer parade ground as the central datum of the post reservation.
